summary: Increment #4-MULTIPLY of the world-engine history program (GROUND track): the volcanic analog of the shipped #2 (plate driver-response). It threads the per-body D-vector (bodyDrivers channel) through route()->writeBodyRelief->writeMagmatismSphere (today `void drivers`, magmatism.js:122) so plume COUNT/STRENGTH derive from thermal history (tidal-heat + radiogenic/age, i.e. thermalState) instead of the uniform [0.4,1.0] seed draw; AND it derives a seeded volcanic fissure fabric (per-plume major-axis, disjoint 'magma:grain:' alea stream) + an ELONGATION_GAIN knob so edifices are elongated/fissure-aligned instead of the isotropic (1-r)^p circular dome. Both are one thermal driver. It uses the EXISTING tune-merge seam (magmatism.js:124, tune ? {...MAGMA_DEFAULTS,...tune} : MAGMA_DEFAULTS) and mirrors #2's driversToTune discipline exactly: magmaDriversToTune(MAGMA_REF) returns null so the writer runs #4a BYTE-IDENTICAL at the neutral-driver reference point. Grain-alignment is DERIVED (not carrier.grainAngle, which grounding proved is zero/latitude-binary on the volcanic path — GROUNDING.md §4). No edits to plates.js/shellRelief.js/tectonic.js/sphereField.js; the dispatch predicate stays in planet-lod-rivers.js; no 4th carrier.regime; alea 'magma:' namespace only; #4a seed-only output is the reference baseline.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: BYTE-IDENTICAL AT THE NEUTRAL REFERENCE + DETERMINISM (the load-bearing #2 regression guard): magmaDriversToTune(MAGMA_REF) === null and, with ELONGATION_GAIN at its default 0, writeMagmatismSphere reproduces #4a's fields byte-for-byte for every seed x body-case; no new Math.random/Date.now, no new convergence while-loop, the new per-plume axis draw uses ONLY the disjoint 'magma:grain:' alea stream so the existing 'magma:*' streams are unperturbed; |U| < MAGMA_BOUND.

verifyVia.input: Call magmaDriversToTune(MAGMA_REF) and assert null. Capture the #4a baseline U/plumeId/hotspotProximity/edificeMask/lavaPlainMask/magmaOceanMask from writeMagmatismSphere(carrier,{},{macroSeed:s,locked:L,T_ss}) for s in {1,2,3,7,42} x L in {false,true}; then run the #4-MULTIPLY writer at the reference (bodyDrivers=null OR MAGMA_REF, tune=null/ELONGATION_GAIN=0) and compare typed arrays. Static-grep magmatism.js for new Math.random/Date.now/while.
verifyVia.observable: magmaDriversToTune(MAGMA_REF)===null; byte-identical typed arrays vs the #4a baseline for every (s,L); zero new RNG/while matches; new axis draws confined to 'magma:grain:'; |U[i]| < MAGMA_BOUND.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: MONOTONE COUNT/STRENGTH RESPONSE (correct sign): at a FIXED seed, increasing the thermal driver H (more tidal-heat / younger) monotonically increases plumeCount AND the mean edifice amplitude; decreasing H decreases them; at/below the reference the field collapses to #4a. This is what makes size distribution track thermal history instead of 'one giant + arbitrary smaller'.

verifyVia.input: Fix macroSeed; build the field at a monotone sweep of bodyDrivers thermal values H0<H1<H2 (H0=reference); read plumeCount and mean(U over edificeMask) at each.
verifyVia.observable: plumeCount(H0) <= plumeCount(H1) <= plumeCount(H2) and mean-edifice-amplitude strictly non-decreasing in H (correct sign, no inversion); at H0 the output equals #4a.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: GRAIN ANISOTROPY (structure must PASS) WITHOUT re-introducing latitude (control must FAIL): at non-reference drivers, edifices are measurably ELONGATED and oriented along the seeded per-plume axis (not isotropic, not random, not latitude), AND #4a's load-bearing latitude falsifier still holds. Breaks the 'crude / too regular circular dome' read.

verifyVia.input: At non-reference H, for each plume measure the edifice footprint's principal-axis aspect ratio and the alignment of its major axis to the seeded per-plume axis; separately correlate U vs sin^2(carrier +y latitude). At the reference, confirm edifices are isotropic (aspect ~1).
verifyVia.observable: mean edifice aspect ratio > 1 (elongated) by a set margin AND major-axis-vs-seededAxis alignment high (anisotropy is grain-organized, not noise); varExplainedByLatitudeY < 0.15 AND < varExplainedByPlume (AC3-of-#4a preserved); aspect ~1 at the reference.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: #4a STRUCTURE PRESERVED UNDER ELONGATION + SWEEP: the elevation ordering mean(edifice) > mean(lava-plain) > mean(magma-ocean basin) holds across the driver sweep, the plume-organization signal (arm's-length plume predictor) is not destroyed by elongation, and the shipped #4a magma-structure suite stays green.

verifyVia.input: Across the H sweep and both body-cases, recompute the mean-ordering and the arm's-length corr(U, plume-proximity predictor); run the existing magma-structure vitest suite.
verifyVia.observable: mean(edifice) > mean(plain) > mean(basin) for every sweep point; corr(U, plume predictor) stays above the #4a bar (AC2-of-#4a-equivalent) once basin geometry is excluded; the #4a structure suite passes unchanged.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: NO-CLOBBER + DISPATCH SAFETY: the plate, shell, and despun paths are byte-identical to their pre-change baselines (bodyDrivers stays null off the volcanic path, exactly as #2), the volcanic gate order (plate -> shell -> volcanic -> despun) is unchanged, and no out-of-scope file is edited.

verifyVia.input: Call writeBodyRelief with terrestrial/ocean (plate), Europa (shell), impact-airless unlocked (despun) and confirm byte-identical fields + null magma tune; git-diff the commit; run the no-clobber + regime-gate harness.
verifyVia.observable: plate/shell/despun U byte-identical to baseline with magmaDiag.appliedTune null off the volcanic path; git show touches ONLY magmatism.js, planet-lod-rivers.js, planet-lod-lab.html, the magma test(s), and workstream docs (NOT plates.js/shellRelief.js/tectonic.js/sphereField.js); carrier.regime untouched (verify.js regime in {0,1,2}); the plate/shell regime-gate suites pass.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: LIVE driver sweep visibly changes the volcano field: in the running lab, at a FIXED seed, sweeping the thermal driver turns a low-thermal volcanic world into a visibly different (more/bigger, more elongated) high-thermal world, and the actual Lava/Magma presets at their real drivers render elongated/fissure-aligned edifices (not perfect circles) vs the #4a skeleton.

verifyVia.input: In the lab (fresh tab of the running Chrome) select Lava (then Magma), setSeed(1234), reliefBakeStrength(1), drive the new thermal-driver override low->high (or A/B), force a route each time, magmaProbe(), screenshot. Confirm magmaProbe exposes appliedTune + plumeCount + an elongation measure.
verifyVia.observable: heightSource=='carrier', regime=='volcanic'; plumeCount and mean edifice amplitude rise from low->high thermal at fixed seed; magmaProbe reports appliedTune non-null and an aspect>1 elongation at high thermal; screenshots show elongated/fissure-aligned edifices at high thermal vs rounder at the reference; Lava and Magma at their real preset drivers read distinctly more natural than the #4a circular skeleton.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: UAT (Max-only): the volcanic worlds now read as NATURAL volcanic worlds — plume sizes track thermal history (not a coin-flip 'one giant + arbitrary smaller'), edifices read as fissure-aligned rather than perfect circles, and Lava/Magma still cohere as recognizable volcanic worlds. Holistic acceptance; never PASSed by any agent.

verifyVia.input: Max views Lava and Magma in the lab, sweeps the thermal-driver control, and judges the result against the 'crude / too regular' read that motivated this increment.
verifyVia.observable: Max judges the volcano sizes as history-tracking and the shapes as natural/fissure-aligned rather than isotropic circular domes, cohering as the volcanic worlds he wanted. Deferred-to-max.

mustFix: #1 CALIBRATION (load-bearing; pin in PLAN before implementing SLICE B): define MAGMA_REF as a named Object.freeze constant and calibrate magmaDriversToTune so f(MAGMA_REF) === null -> #4a byte-identical (analog of #2's D_EARTH must-fix). CRITICAL RISK to resolve first: verify the ACTUAL Lava (hot airless) and Magma (K2-141b) lab presets carry thermal drivers (tidalHeat/age) that place them OFF MAGMA_REF so they visibly improve. If the lab presets carry defaults (tidalHeat~0, age~0.5) that coincide with a neutral MAGMA_REF, the shipped worlds will NOT change and AC6/AC7 fail. Mitigations (decide in PLAN): (a) surface a real tidalHeat for volcanic presets (mirror #2's 'age surfaced first'); and/or (b) fold T_eq/T_ss (which DOES vary: Lava 950 vs Magma 2000) into the thermal driver H as an endogenic-activity proxy — but keep irradiation (T_ss, a shading/basin input) conceptually distinct from endogenic plume heat; document the choice.

#2 ELONGATION mechanism (SLICE B): per-plume seeded major-axis via alea('magma:grain:'+seed) (disjoint) + E = 1 + ELONGATION_GAIN * H' (H' = thermal deviation from reference, so E=1 at the reference). Anisotropic normalized radius: build a tangent frame at each plume top, decompose the geodesic displacement to node i into along-axis/cross-axis components, r_aniso = hypot(along/(radius*E), cross/radius). ELONGATION_GAIN default 0 (circular #4a). Must preserve edifice>plain>basin (the moat/swell/flood math keys off the same edificeMask) and AC3.

#3 BYTE-IDENTITY discipline (mirror #2): magmaDriversToTune returns only changed fields; an identity guard returns null when every override equals its MAGMA_DEFAULT AND ELONGATION_GAIN maps to 0 -> the tune?{...}:DEFAULTS ternary takes the untouched branch. The new 'magma:grain:' draw must be positioned so it does not shift any existing stream's byte output at the reference (a fresh alea instance, not an extra pull on an existing rng).

GRAIN SOURCE IS DERIVED, NOT carrier.grainAngle (GROUNDING.md §4): carrier.grainAngle is zero-inited on the volcanic path (writeGrainSphere runs only on the despun branch) and is a binary latitude value where written (tectonic.js) — aligning to it would trip AC3. Do NOT read it; derive the seeded fabric.

OUT OF SCOPE: no edits to plates.js/shellRelief.js/tectonic.js/sphereField.js; no game Planet.js port (lab-only, #9); Venus #4b + Mars stagnant-lid remain separate; the basin-vs-plain legibility + weathering reads stay deferred (#8 palette/F41, #7/#8 weathering) per the #4a UAT.
